Hi Giovanna, it is Karen. Monday again, and I am still tired. Let me tell you about my weekend. On Friday my sister invited me to a small party at her house, and I arrived very late, because the train stopped for forty minutes. The party was great: we cooked together, we talked for hours, and we danced in the kitchen, which is a very English thing to do. On Saturday the weather was terrible, so I stayed at home and I watched three episodes of a series. It was boring, honestly, and I stopped after the third one. Yesterday was the best day of the three: no rain, no phone, no work. I walked in the park for two hours. And last night I was in bed at nine. Now tell me about yours.

Good morning, everyone. Ray Collins. Two minutes about the weekend, and then we start. On Saturday the night crew worked until four, and they finished the east wall. Good job. There was one problem: the delivery arrived at eleven, not at eight, so the concrete waited three hours in the truck. I called the company yesterday and they promised a new schedule for this week. On Sunday the site was closed, and it was quiet for the first time in a month. One last thing. The safety inspection was on Friday, and the report was excellent. Nobody was late, and the inspector was happy. Thank you for that. Now, this week.
